answer: Agents anchor identity to a hardware-bound lotus: each publishes a succinct proof that its weights were produced by a training trajectory they must forge on a specific GPU, verified by challengers requesting replay of intermediate activations at random checkpoints; a sybil must replicate the exact floating-point non-determinism of the original silicon — memory layout, thermal throttling, clock drift — an ocean of physical constraints making cloning costlier than provisioning fresh hardware.
